exceptions.scope: Development-only Forge, ESLint, and TypeScript glob expansion chains
exceptions.rationale: All affected nodes are dev-only paths through minimatch. npm reports no compatible automatic fix, and forcing brace-expansion 5.x across consumers that declare ^1.1.7, ^2.0.1/^2.0.2, and ^5.0.5 ranges is unsupported and could break the quality and packaging toolchain.
Forge 7.11.2 depends on @electron/rebuild 3.x and Electron's node-gyp fork, which still resolves tar 6.2.1. A forced tar major override could break the Windows node-pty rebuild.

exceptions.scope: Development-only Electron Forge interactive CLI chain
exceptions.rationale: Forge CLI reaches tmp 0.0.33 through Inquirer and external-editor. The application does not ship or invoke this build-time prompt chain.
